passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
passive.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.
spells.tooltip:
Vex launches a wave of mist that deals {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Vex gains {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds and emits a shockwave that deals {{ wdamagecalc }} magic damage.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by {{ gloomcdnonchamptooltip*100 }}%.

Applies Gloom to enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.
spells.tooltip:
Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing {{ spell.vexr:rdamagecalc }} magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.

Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing {{ spell.vexr:recastdamagecalc }} magic damage on arrival.

If the marked champion dies within {{ spell.vexr:takedownwindow }} seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Doom 'n Gloom
effects: Passive - Doom: Periodically, Vex empowers her next basic ability to knock down and fear enemies hit for 0.75 / 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 (based on level) seconds, during which they are slowed by 60% : 99% (based on distance from Vex). If Looming Darkness triggers Doom, enemies hit will flee from the epicenter instead.Doom's cooldown resets upon respawning.

Innate - Gloom: Nearby enemy champions and monsters that dash or blink will be marked with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next basic attack, which becomes non-projectile, or basic ability hit against an enemy with Gloom will detonate the mark. Looming Darkness will also inflict Gloom, but cannot detonate it.

Gloom's detonation deals 40 : 150 (based on level) (+ 25% AP) bonus magic damage and refunds 25% of Doom's cooldown. Against non-champions, this instead deals 40% / 45% / 50% / 55% / 60% (based on level) damage and refunds 10% of Doom's cooldown.

variants.name: Personal Space
effects: Vex can move during Personal Space's cast time.

variants.name: Looming Darkness
effects: Killing an enemy with Looming Darkness refunds 10% of Doom's cooldown, increased to 25% for champion kills.

variants.name: Shadow Surge
effects: Shadow stops upon hitting an enemy champion to mark them for 4 seconds, during which they are revealed. Shadow Surge can be recast while the target is marked.
If Vex scores a takedown against Shadow Surge's marked target within 6 seconds of its application, Vex can cast Shadow Surge again within 12 seconds at no cost after 0.5 seconds.
